suite.name: pilot_hires_kvasir_v1
suite.purpose: Screening pilot. The detail branch reads a 448 input but its output and supervision are 224. Tests whether producing and supervising the prediction at 448 helps, and separates the effect of supervision resolution from the effect of the detail features. Source Val only; no Test access.
suite.prompt: a polyp in a colonoscopy image

arm_notes.sup448: no detail branch; native 56x56 logits upsampled bilinearly to 448 and supervised with a 448 mask
arm_notes.detail448: detail decoder continued by one stage to 448 (8-channel 448 stem, fuse, zero-initialised 1x1 output); 448 supervision

suite.hyperparameters: identical to the accepted 30-epoch Kvasir pilots (config derived from the accepted configuration)
suite.evaluation: source Val, final epoch 30, fixed sentence

gate.description: Fixed before training. Statistic is the mean over the two seeds of paired differences, in percentage points.
gate.if_pass: formal three-seed 100-epoch training on Kvasir and BUSI, new locked suite
gate.if_fail: stop this direction; keep the accepted 224 detail branch

reference_30_epoch_results.note: accepted earlier pilots with the same configuration; used only as a reproduction check
